indicators.label: Apprenticeship starts (Wales)
indicators.subtitle: Apprenticeship programme starts by people aged 16 or above, per 100,000 people
indicators.longDescription: This indicator shows apprenticeships started by adults aged 16+ based on home address, rate per 100,000 population, in Wales, for full academic years 2012/13 to 2024/25.
indicators.caveats: Rates per 100,000 population aged 16 years and over have been calculated using [Wales mid-year population estimates](https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/datasets/pestsyoala), which are currently available up to mid-2025.  Figures produced by each UK nation may differ due to differing sources, time periods, age analysed or differences in methodologies so they are not directly comparable.

indicators.label: Apprenticeship achievements (Wales)
indicators.subtitle: Apprenticeship programme achievements by people aged 16 or above, per 100,000 people
indicators.longDescription: This indicator shows apprenticeships achieved by adults aged 16+ based on home address, rate per 100,000 population, in Wales, for full academic years 2016/17 to 2024/25.
indicators.caveats: The standard outcome measures were not produced in the 2019/20 and 2020/21 academic year due to the pandemic.  Rates per 100,000 population aged 16 years and over have been calculated using [Wales mid-year population estimates](https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/datasets/pestsyoala), which are currently available up to mid-2025.  Figures produced by each UK nation may differ due to differing sources, time periods, age analysed or differences in methodologies so they are not directly comparable.
